The discharge summary did not address nephrology's opinion. If the attending maintains AKI, ask for clinical indicators.

The progress note and discharge summary appear to carry forward the H&P's AKI diagnosis after nephrology's contrary assessment, with the 2022 comparison unaddressed. Treat this as a possible copy-forward in the query.
